subject.title: refactor(discord): authorize widgets by channel audience

question: Should configured Discord account allowlists stop restricting widget content and be replaced by exact Discord Activity instance/channel membership for existing installations?
rationale: This is an intentional authorization-policy change on a public HTTPS Activity surface, and current documentation presents the account allowlists as part of the widget security model.

options.title: Adopt channel audience with an upgrade contract
options.body: Keep the new instance-and-channel policy, but explicitly document and validate how existing configured allowlists cease to gate widgets.

options.title: Preserve account allowlists for widgets
options.body: Retain the existing allowlist gate so widget visibility continues to match the bot account's configured audience.

options.title: Add an explicit Activities audience policy
options.body: Introduce a narrowly documented opt-in only if maintainers need both audience models as supported operator choices.

recommendation.title: Adopt channel audience with an upgrade contract
recommendation.body: Keep the new instance-and-channel policy, but explicitly document and validate how existing configured allowlists cease to gate widgets.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR and its stated maintainer-requested correction place steipete closest to the proposed Discord Activity audience policy.
